candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with direct transfer of contract balance to msg.sender, changing behavior when withdraw is overridden or guarded.
Remove the call to withdraw and instead call withdraw with zero value, preventing funds from being sent.
Relax onlyOwner to allow anyone to call functions guarded by it by changing require to always pass (no ownership check).
Tighten onlyOwner to revert with an explicit message on non-owner calls, changing observable revert behavior.
Insert a reentrancy by calling withdraw before clearing any state (increment) — here we insert a depositsCount increment to create an observable state change timing difference.
Replace transfer of _value to msg.sender with sending only half the requested amount (/_value/2) so withdraw transfers a different balance.
Replace transfer with a call that forwards all gas and returns success but does not revert on failure, changing whether funds are actually sent to the caller.
Alter onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender equals tx.origin instead of owner, changing who is authorized to call withdraw.
